title: Bulk order from Lindqvist Studio
summary: Mara Lindqvist placed a 48-unit order for the autumn catalogue, with delivery requested before 20 October. Payment cleared on the first attempt.

title: Login loop on the mobile site
summary: Three customers were sent back to the login page after signing in on Safari. Clearing the session cookie works around it; a proper fix is planned for the next release.

title: Checkout 2.4.0
summary: Address autocomplete now covers the whole of the Nordics, and the order confirmation email shows the delivery window.

title: September invoices sent
summary: All 212 September invoices went out on schedule. Two bounced and need a manual follow-up.

title: First order from Wierzba & Co
summary: Tomasz Wierzba ordered twelve sample sets after the trade fair. The account is flagged for a follow-up call once the samples arrive.

title: Refund delayed for order 3088
summary: Jonah Bell's refund was issued on 1 October but has not reached his card. The payment provider confirmed it is in transit and should settle within two days.

title: Inventory sync hotfix
summary: Stock levels no longer drift after a cancelled order. The sync now re-reads the warehouse count instead of applying a delta.

title: Card declines down 12%
summary: Retrying declined cards 24 hours later recovered 31 payments last week. The retry window stays at one day for now.

title: Repeat order from Haddad Interiors
summary: Leila Haddad reordered the spring collection in the same quantities as last year. Dispatch is booked for Thursday.

title: CSV export missing the notes column
summary: Priya Raman reported that the order export drops the notes column when any note contains a line break. Reproduced; fix scheduled for 2.4.2.

title: Dunning emails resumed
summary: The overdue-invoice reminders paused on 30 September are running again. 17 reminders went out this morning.
